summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing of SewaKontrak Pro. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (auth, register, login, forgot-password generic, documents CRUD, filters, stats, attachments upload/delete, unauthorized access). Frontend: verified unauthenticated redirect to /login, admin login, dashboard stats (6/3/2/1 seed data confirmed), reminder banner with 2 items, banner link opens detail drawer with days-remaining, search filter (1 row for 'Samsung'), status filter Berakhir (1 row), add document via modal, edit document, delete via confirm dialog, Export CSV downloads dokumen-sewa-YYYY-MM-DD.csv, logout redirects to /login, responsive mobile view (doc-card-list visible, doc-table hidden at 390px).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS: only allows single FRONTEND_URL origin; acceptable given cookie-based auth requires explicit origin, but no fallback if env is missing (defaults to http://localhost:3000).
Attachment download endpoint /api/files/{path} requires auth cookie — anchor links to it from the drawer will work only for authenticated sessions (fine, but PDFs cannot be shared).
server.py is 629 lines, still manageable but nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting auth and documents into separate modules.
put_object/get_object are sync `requests` calls inside async handlers — blocks the event loop. Should use httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.
seed_admin uses .strip().lower() for env admin email but README/test_credentials.md list dikhawilham77@gmail.com — ensure ADMIN_EMAIL env matches to keep seed idempotent.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 6 sample lease docs and admin user automatically on startup. Tests created/deleted TEST_ prefixed documents; no seed data was permanently modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all API surface (auth, docs CRUD, attachments, filters, stats). Reuse admin_session fixture. For attachment tests, storage service may be transient — test is guarded with pytest.skip on 502.
